title: 🏛️ RBI Signs Section 21A Agreement with GNCTD for Public Debt & ₹890 Cr WMA Limit
summary: RBI entered into Agreement under Sec 21A of RBI Act 1934 with Government of NCT of Delhi (effective 9 Jan 2026) to manage its banking and public debt. WMA limit for Delhi fixed at ₹890 crore (revised aggregate State/UT WMA limit ₹61,008 crore; UP highest at ₹6,519 Cr).
